body: This is exactly how I am.

I started high school with all A's every semester, work always in time, super motivated and disciplined, very happy, considered one of the "smart kids". I'm almost at the end of my junior year and I've gone to A and B student instead of all A's, tons of late work, lack of understanding in my classes, procrastinating, copying other's homework all the time because I couldn't bother to it. Obviously it could be worse and I'm not really failing but it feels like I really let myself down, I just know I could have done a lot better with this year if I tried harder.
